items.t: V6 burns oil between changes
items.job: Diagnose oil use (compression and leak-down test), then oil control ring cleaning or engine overhaul
items.note: This covers diagnosis and a ring cleaning treatment. A full engine replacement is priced separately below and costs far more.

items.t: Engine knocks or seizes after running low on oil
items.job: Replace engine with a used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Owners report paying about $4,000 to $6,500 for a replacement engine.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace the automatic transmission
items.note: One owner reported about $1,500 for a rebuild; a remanufactured unit costs more.

items.t: Transmission light on with code P1870
items.job: Diagnose torque converter clutch slip; fluid service or valve body repair
items.note: If the converter or clutches are worn, a full rebuild is needed instead.

items.t: Rough idle or stalling from leaking intake gaskets
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $633 to $857 total for these years.

items.t: Engine surges or idle stays high
items.job: Diagnose and clean or replace throttle body, idle control valve or throttle sensor

items.t: Idle fluctuates with throttle sensor codes
items.job: Adjust or replace accelerator position sensor

items.t: Check engine light with ignition module code P1340
items.job: Diagnose and replace ion sensing ignition module

items.t: Transmission codes P1640 or P1650 from the engine computer
items.job: Diagnose PCM output driver circuits and repair wiring
items.note: If the computer itself has failed, replacing it costs more.

items.t: Fuel line can separate in a frontal crash (recall)
items.job: Install fuel system shields
items.note: Free if never done. Isuzu no longer sells vehicles in the US, so call ahead to find a shop that handles Isuzu recalls.

items.t: Fuel hose can leak in a crash on Torque-on-Demand models (recall)
items.job: Install reinforced fuel hose assembly

items.t: Transfer case flange nuts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect, torque and stake transfer case flange nuts

items.t: Left front brake line rubs on the suspension (recall)
items.job: Inspect clearance and replace left front brake line

items.t: Rear center seat belt buckle won't latch (recall)
items.job: Replace rear center seat belt buckle

items.t: Front wheel bearing nut can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect front hubs and install missing lock parts

items.t: Valve ticking from the 3.2L V6
items.job: Oil change with synthetic oil; replace lash adjusters if noise remains
items.note: Most owners only need the oil change; the high end is for replacing the adjusters.

items.t: 4WD light on while in two-wheel drive
items.job: Replace front axle vacuum solenoid valve

items.t: Frame and suspension mounts rust through
items.job: Repair rusted frame sections and suspension mounts
items.note: Severe rot may cost more than the truck is worth.

items.t: Manual transmission clutch fails
items.job: Replace clutch, pressure plate and throwout bearing

items.t: Windshield molding taps in the wind
items.job: Secure or replace windshield molding
